title: Trail Valley Creek soil roughness from airborne lidar
description: Per-station soil surface roughness retrieved from 2018 airborne lidar at Trail Valley Creek. These are the numbers a rough-surface substrate needs, so use them when driving a model at one of these stations instead of guessing a roughness.
citation: Montpetit, B., King, J., Siqueira, P., Adam, J. M., Toose, P., Derksen, C., and Brady, M. (2024). TVC Experiment 2018/19 [Dataset]. Zenodo. Published in Montpetit et al., The Cryosphere, 18, 3857-3874, 2024, https://doi.org/10.5194/tc-18-3857-2024.
derivation: Reshaped from the published mapping into rows. Values unchanged.

mean_square_slope.description: Mean square slope, the parameter the geometrical optics substrate uses.
